name: Feed + tension
purpose: Present prepared veneer to the winding guide at a stable, measured tension.
inputs: prepared (wet) veneer strip or blank from the approved lab process
tension setpoint and trip limit from the recipe
outputs: strip at the guide entry under known tension
tension samples (HX711) and dancer position (A0 raw, reported in STATUS as dancer=)
printed: F09 spool stand left (608 pocket, replaces F01)
F10 spool hubs x2 (8 mm bore, replace F03)
F08 load-cell cradle + F13 clamp cap
purchased: 10 kOhm pot with 6 mm shaft (dancer pivot)
2 x MR62ZZ (2 x 6 x 2.5 mm) on an M2 x 16 screw axle (sensing roller)
M2 screws only (thread-forming into printed pilots, wood screws into plywood)
software: firmware: two consecutive samples above SET_TENSION_MAX trip SAFE_STOP (TENSION_HIGH); PRETENSION waits for SET_TENSION_MIN
firmware: optional speed trim on tension above setpoint is present but DISABLED (gain 0) until the material window is known
host: logs TENSION lines per cycle
calibration: TARE with the strip slack, then CAL_TENSION=<N> with a known hanging mass over the actual roller path
measure damage and break tension per material lot (Phase 0) before choosing SET_TENSION_MAX
record the drag setting and dancer angle at the chosen tension
acceptance: tension trace stays inside the experimentally established band
load-cell calibration repeatable within 5 % over three tare/cal cycles
risks: guide traverses +-50 mm, so the strip angle between the load-cell roller and the guide changes during a cycle
dancer and drag are passive: tension depends on friction that changes as felt wets
IMU vibration is not tension - do not use it as the process variable

name: Synchronized winding
status: core - designed, CAD-checked; firmware compile-tested + unit-tested
purpose: Rotate the 0.8 mm mandrel while translating the guide so the strip forms a helix with the recipe pitch and exact turn count.
inputs: recipe: pitch, turns, sacrificial turns, rate, acceleration, start position
outputs: TURN events, COMPLETE line with rotation and linear step totals
printed: W01 NEMA17 rotation mount (R3, defines the 37.0 mm axis)
W05 end guide (R3) + W13 11 mm riser
W15/W16 NEMA17 body clamps (NEMA17 face holes are M3, so motors are clamped by the body with M2 screws)
purchased: mini drill chuck on 5 mm arbor
T8x8 lead screw 250 mm + flange nut
electronics: A4988 rotation STEP/DIR -> D2/D3; linear STEP/DIR -> D4/D5; shared ENABLE D6 (active low, 10 k pull-up)
12 V switched actuator rail with 100 uF at each VMOT
software: Timer1 interrupt Bresenham: the axis with more steps is master; the other never steps more than once per tick; totals exact
homing before every cycle; home re-check flags skipped steps (2 strikes -> SAFE_STOP)
calibration: linear: jog 50 mm and measure with calipers -> steps/mm
rotation: mark the chuck, command 10 turns, count
pitch: wind a test coil, measure length/turns on the mandrel
set A4988 current (Vref) before connecting motors
acceptance: exact commanded turn count (vision + COMPLETE line)
pitch repeatability within the tolerance the functional tests accept
risks: 0.8 mm mandrel deflects ~1 mm at 0.5 N over 90 mm
F06 channel position is inferred - measure before relying on the 37.65 mm strip height
carriage window depends on guide angle (+60 deg: x 85-150 mm only)

name: Clamp + cut + demold
status: core - sequence SOFTWARE-TESTED (host tests + simulator); mounting to the core cell open
purpose: Hold only the sacrificial region, cut with a guarded purchased shear, support the wet coil in a compliant split fixture and withdraw the mandrel without dragging the coil over an undercut.
inputs: accepted wet coil on the mandrel (VERIFY passed)
outputs: free wet body in the open split support, ready for the drying tray
printed: X02 soft clamp jaws x2 (1 mm silicone)
electronics: PCA9685 CH0 clamp, CH1 cutter, CH6 demold support on the 5 V servo rail (cut by the E-stop)
software: CLAMP -> CUT (stroke, rest) -> DEMOLD (support close, relative axial retraction, support open, clamp release) -> COMPLETE
calibration: tune servo pulse widths (constants in sf_controller.h) with the linkage disconnected first
find the minimum clamp force that holds the sacrificial tail
measure the wet coil OD; size the W07/W08 silicone lining
acceptance: no visible delamination from clamp or demold
coil never dragged over a closed undercut
risks: mechanism placement not designed yet (W07 pocket axis 17 mm vs 37 mm)

name: Auxiliary tail forming
status: experimental - R3 fixture parts, not built
purpose: Form the two auxiliary tails as a separate bench module first, so tail variables are isolated from body winding.
inputs: wet tail blanks (27 / 29.5 / 32.5 mm path length references)
outputs: formed wet tails released without tearing
printed: T01/T02 split former halves (14 mm radius, 4.8 mm channel)
T03 servo sweep shoe (needs repair: detached tab)
software: future TAIL_FORM state (not implemented in v0.3)
calibration: sweep angle and dwell per material lot
dried tail shape vs PR02-PR04 envelopes
acceptance: dried shape repeatable enough to seat in S04
three tails sit 120 deg apart without forcing
risks: former radius is a starting value

name: Free drying
purpose: Let wet bodies and tails dry unrestrained so no fixture forces the final geometry; an asynchronous buffer between forming and assembly.
outputs: dry parts with logged drying history
electronics: optional I2C temp/RH on the host or ESP32
software: host log: material lot, recipe, timestamp, temperature, humidity, tray position, dry release time, dry dimensions
calibration: measure mass loss over time on a sample tray to define 'dry'
acceptance: dry geometry stable enough to assemble
no fixture-induced flattening or permanent deformation

name: Seed + tip + three-tail assembly
purpose: Place the dry body and two auxiliary tails 120 deg apart, present exactly one seed, apply a small adhesive dose only to inactive joints, form the biodegradable tip.
printed: S01 hopper (needs repair) + S02 singulator disk
S07/S08 tip mould MASTERS (cast compliant working inserts)
purchased: M5 threaded rod (syringe drive screw - a motion part, not a fastener)
software: future ASSEMBLE state; early tests use manual seed presentation
calibration: seed pocket size per species
adhesive dose per joint by mass
risks: do not heat live seed unless viability testing supports it

name: Computer-vision QA
status: core camera in Phase 1; software tested on synthetic images only
purpose: Measure the coil deterministically and stop the machine on a defect: body length, turn count, pitch, gap, overlap, gross deformation (later: tails, tip, seed).
inputs: back-lit overhead image of the coil
printed: W18 camera arm (board camera on 4 x M2)
purchased: 38 x 38 mm USB board camera, manual-focus M12 lens (about 6 mm focal length), M2 holes
5 V white LED strip + printed diffuser as back-light
plywood mast strip cut from the base offcut
electronics: camera on the host; only events go to the controller
software: seedforge.vision: Otsu segmentation, PCA alignment, edge-notch spacing = local pitch, bulge test separates overlap from gap
HEARTBEAT every 500 ms; the Uno stops if it is missing for 3 s in WIND or VERIFY
calibration: px/mm from a target in the coil plane
thresholds from a labelled set of real good and bad coils
risks: synthetic images were designed alongside the pipeline: their 16/16 score is a software test, not validation
overlap is inferred, not seen, in a silhouette

name: Output storage
purpose: Keep finished carriers isolated and traceable so tails do not tangle.
printed: O01 twelve-pocket tray (resize pockets to the measured dry envelope)
software: carrier ID -> tray position in carriers.csv notes
calibration: measure the dry carrier envelope

name: XY transfer (optional)
purpose: Move fixtures or parts between proven stations, gripping only handling tabs or fixtures - never the active coil.
inputs: parts in fixtures at station pick points
outputs: parts placed at the next station
purchased: donor 3D-printer XY gantry (keeps its own hardware; R parts attach with M2)
electronics: separate motion node recommended (the Uno timing budget is for winding)
calibration: station pick/place coordinates after homing
acceptance: power loss cannot drop the Z axis into a hazard

name: Drone cassette (optional, downstream)
purpose: Release one finished carrier at a time at unique, pre-assigned planting points, using a proven aircraft and an independent payload controller.
inputs: sector plan with unique point IDs
outputs: released carriers with a logged point ID each
purchased: payload kit (about $18): RP2040 board, 4 x SG90 gate servos, 4 x TCRT5000 IR confirm sensors, 5 V BEC, leads
aircraft if not owned: ArduPilot-supported F405 FC + ESC stack, F450-class frame, 2212 motors, M10 GPS, 3S LiPo
optional: Pi Zero 2 W + camera for terrain classification
electronics: flight-controller servo/relay output -> RP2040 GPIO (release request at each waypoint)
RP2040 -> 4 gate servos; 4 IR sensors -> RP2040
servos on their own 5 V BEC
software: seedforge.deploy.ledger: intent persisted before release; uncertain releases are never retried automatically
calibration: loaded mass and CG
thrust margin
door retention and release on the bench, hundreds of cycles
